text: AuthPLAIN returns one object with username/password; AuthCRAM returns username/digest. The human JSDoc patch made tags validator-valid, but current comments still repeat @returns to describe object fields. A scoped manual proposal is to document one return shape or a named typedef with properties, while retaining the distinct error contract. Passing JSDoc lint does not prove that a reader or generated page sees an unambiguous shape. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
